brief: Persistent headline volatility drove another week of elevated activity on GS's buyback desk, as corporates used peak post-earnings open windows, particularly Friday, to place opportunistic orders. Desk volumes finished at 2.2x 2025 YTD average daily trading volume and 2.4x 2024 YTD ADTV, with flows skewed toward Industrials, Financials, and Consumer Discretionary. The weekly execution mix shifted toward discretionary orders: 47% open market versus 53% 10b5-1, up from 45%/55% the prior week. GS currently estimates 96% of the market is in its open window and at peak participation, and expects participation to taper into year end as corporate blackout periods begin in early to mid December. For the full year, GS expects 2026 market-wide buyback authorizations to finish at $1.65 trillion and executions at $1.4 trillion. Separately, 32 new repurchase programs were authorized this week for a combined $15.7 billion, an active week for new authorizations.
